test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Arrange the names of the following Indian presidents in the descending order of their tenure.

A. Fakhruddin Ali Ahmed

B. Neelam Sanjiva Reddy

C. Dr. Zakir Hussain

D. Giani Zail Singh
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• To arrange the names of the Indian presidents in the descending order of their tenure:
 
 
• **Giani Zail Singh (1982-1987)**
 
• **Neelam Sanjiva Reddy (1977-1982)**
 
• **Fakhruddin Ali Ahmed (1974-1977)**
 
• **Dr. Zakir Hussain (1967-1969)**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Giani Zail Singh served as the 7th President of India from 25 July 1982 to 25 July 1987.
 
• Neelam Sanjiva Reddy served as the 6th President of India from 25 July 1977 to 25 July 1982.
 
• Fakhruddin Ali Ahmed served as the 5th President of India from 24 August 1974 until his death on 11 February 1977.
 
• Dr. Zakir Hussain served as the 3rd President of India from 13 May 1967 until his death on 3 May 1969.
